messages:
Maria V: CI red on main after merging PR #7892 — flaky failing test in CI job `linux-x86_64-e2e`:
`tests/inference/test_embedding_cache.py::test_cache_eviction_ordering`
Link: https://ci.redwood.com/flow/98234/job/1132

CI-bot: build 98234/job/1132 FAILED — exit code 1. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/flow/98234/job/1132/logs

Jon P: ack. Maria, do we have the last-green commit for that job?

Maria V: last green for that pipeline was commit z9y8x7w6 (merged ~6h before). The PR that merged is a refactor of scheduler ordering from @sasha. Commit range from z9y8x7w6..HEAD includes the scheduler reorder + a small test helper tweak.

Liam K: quick triage — can someone paste the failing stacktrace?

Maria V: stacktrace snippet: 
```
AssertionError: order mismatch: expected [A,B,C] got [B,A,C]
  at tests/inference/test_embedding_cache.py:48
```
Repro locally on my macbook doesn't fail. CI runs with python3.10, gcc9.4.0.

Sasha T: that sounds like ordering nondeterminism from the new scheduler traversal we landed. I added `sorted(...)` in one place but maybe not the cache eviction path. I'll take a look.

Ravi S: if it's a likely ordering bug, bisect would be fastest. Maria, can you start a bisect run on the CI runner image? If not, I can queue one.

Maria V: I can kick off an automated bisect job. Plan: rerun e2e with `pytest -k "cache_eviction" -q` across commits using our bisect pipeline. Starting at HEAD, good=z9y8x7w6.

Jon P: FYI reuse the bisect script: `./scripts/ci_bisect.sh --job linux-x86_64-e2e --test tests/inference/test_embedding_cache.py::test_cache_eviction_ordering --good z9y8x7w6`

CI-bot: Bisect job queued as 98236. See https://ci.redwood.com/flow/98236 for progress.

Liam K: I'll watch the bisect. If it narrows to the scheduler refactor, we should revert the refactor and push a minimal fix; no point blocking main longer than necessary.

Sasha T: agreed. If bisect points to my commit (commit a1b2c3d4) I can prepare a revert+fix PR. Also will add deterministic iteration or an explicit sort in cache eviction path.

Maria V: bisect job 98236 started. I'll post updates. If anyone wants to run a local reproduce with docker image `redwood/ci-runner:2026-03-17` that's helpful. Command to repro same env:
`docker run --rm -v $REPO:/src -w /src redwood/ci-runner:2026-03-17 bash -lc "pytest -k cache_eviction -q"`

Jon P: pinging @SRE to give the bisect runner a bit more CPU quota if it times out. :pray:

Ravi S: noted — SRE looped in. If the bisect narrows to two commits, we can do a quick manual `git show` comparison to confirm the suspect diff.

CI-bot: Bisect job 98236 update: test failed on commit a1b2c3d4, passed on previous commit f0e1d2c3 — bisect suggests culprit: a1b2c3d4 (scheduler reorder).

Maria V: confirmed. Repro on CI runner with that commit toggled.

Sasha T: thanks — filing PR to revert a1b2c3d4 and add deterministic iteration. Will link PR when ready.

Liam K: once revert PR is up, let's run the full e2e pipeline before merging.

Maria V: I'll hold merging other non-urgent PRs to avoid churn. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
